items.name: week-activity-calendar
items.title: Week Activity Calendar
items.description: A day-of-week × hour-of-day heatmap that merges one or more activity series (arbitrary count kinds) into a single week calendar, with per-cell tooltips and a customizable color scale. Light/dark aware.

items.name: fetch-github-contributions
items.title: Fetch GitHub Contributions
items.description: Server-only loader that returns a WeekActivitySeries of a user's GitHub activity (commits, PRs, issues, reviews, repositories) for a given week. Pair with week-activity-calendar.
